label: Well-foundedness of the supplied demonstration dependency
definition: Every supplied content is accessible in the supplied prior relation. Induction on accessibility propagates the exclusion of knowledge at earlier contents to the target content when the strong rule requires a known earlier used premise.
note: Analyst structural assumption. Strictness and transitivity alone are weaker, as the reverse natural-number priority profile illustrates. Actual well-foundedness and the interpretation of dependence remain open.
